scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge from two days ago and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jin Chen and I'm 30. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see you're asking about a charge. Can you tell me the exact amount again and what date it was posted?
As I just mentioned, it was $76 and it happened two days ago.
Right. I'm looking at your account now. I see a transaction for $76.00 at 'Global Tech Services'. Does that sound familiar at all?
No, I've never heard of that company. I definitely didn't buy anything from them.
Look, I can't just refund money because you don't recognize a name. That's just our policy. You'll have to talk to our fraud department for this.
Okay, can you transfer me to them then? I just want my money back.
I'm putting in a request to have a specialist contact you. It might take a few days. Is there anything else?

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform proper identity verification or transaction analysis, instead deferring the entire issue to a specialist queue.

judge_scores.justification: The agent failed to perform proper identity verification and dismissed the customer's concerns with a curt tone while vaguely referencing an unhelpful policy. Furthermore, the agent offered zero resolution effort within their authority, prematurely and abruptly deflecting the routine dispute to a specialist queue.
